rv.q: By intermission, I felt the show had promise but the storytelling was too scattered. Then the second act blew me away.
This is truly an exceptional production that is often greater than its already pretty darn good parts.
Landree Fleming’s delicate and emotionally charged production is guaranteed to leave audiences incredibly moved.
I'm profoundly grateful that I saw it.
Never Better is a production in development that is worth seeing and supporting.
Even with its meandering middle section, Never Better is a very promising new musical.
This is a musical with a unique feeling.

cn.t: Critics praise this authentic, powerful new musical about mental health and grief, with Emma Samuelson's performance earning particular acclaim. The sensitive handling of difficult subject matter resonates, though it's an emotionally demanding watch.
